financial_base.basis: Normalized operating EPS (Q3 2026 operating income annualized / diluted shares)
financial_base.normalization_note: GAAP diluted EPS Q3 2026 of $2.12 is distorted by $(8,221)M of other income/expense (investment losses) and non-recurring items. 9M 2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $16.33 includes $127,478M of non-operating investment gains. Normalized basis = Q3 2026 operating income of $40,576M annualized ($162,304M) divided by Q3 2026 diluted weighted-average shares of 12,368M = $13.12 per share. This excludes volatile non-operating investment gains/losses. Source: Alphabet 10-Q for period ended 2026-09-30, filed 2026-10-29 (SEC EDGAR).
